summary: Milestone 8 (Functional Evidence Framework) end-to-end acceptance PASSED against the public URL (https://dev-converse.preview.emergentagent.com). Backend: 8/8 pytest passes in /app/backend/tests/test_milestone8_evidence_function.py (351s wall time, 6 live SSE turns + 2 fast CRUD smokes). Frontend: 5/5 UI checks passed. Coverage: (a) STRONG-EVIDENCE/WEAK-INTERPRETATION — 'Teens check their phones 100 times a day, according to a 2023 study. This proves social media is a problem for friendships.' — engine set evidence_function.applies=true, function='Intended to support the claim that social media is a problem for friendships', and named the interpretation gap as 'The statistic is dropped then this proves is asserted — no ...' (the WHY-it-matters edge), NOT 'add more evidence'. (b) WEAK-EVIDENCE/STRONG-INTERPRETATION — the cousin/likes draft: engine honored the sharp claim, set applies=true with function='Intended to ground the claim about measuring closeness in likes vs. time', and oriented instruction toward grounding without supplying any evidence. (c) EMBEDDED SUPPORT RECOGNIZED — process description ('current flows through the filament, which heats until it glows...') → applies=true with function='Grounds the explanation by tracing steps; helps reader visualize the p...'; reflective sensory memory ('The scar on my thumb reminds me of the summer I learned...') → applies=true with function='The scar begins to ground the insight in lived experience...'. (d) UNSUPPORTED CLAIMS — 'Everyone knows social media ruins friendships. It obviously makes people fake.' — read as claim-without-grounding; invitation oriented toward what would ground the point (writing/reader-understanding move), focus='writing', no invented content, no rigid-rule phrasing. (e) M6 REGRESSION — communicative_purpose.primary populated on every turn (persuade/explain/reflect). (f) M7 REGRESSION — paragraph_function.applies=true with populated purpose on every paragraph draft, e.g., 'Introduce the topic and assert an initial position.' rendered in the Dev Panel alongside the new Evidence Function block. (g) M1-M5A/M7 MULTI-TURN — theory_history v1..v3 preserved with prior versions intact (v0=[], v1=rel1, v2=rel2), currently_relevant_domains stayed 2-3 across turns (['Evidence','Interpretation / Reasoning','Paragraph Purpose'] → ['Interpretation / Reasoning','Paragraph Purpose'] → ['Paragraph Purpose','Interpretation / Reasoning']); intervention arc was instruct_then_invite → CONSOLIDATE (on the real revision that added the missing interpretation) → invite_only — the intended Recognize→Name→Understand→Use→Reflect loop firing on evidence work, not just paragraph work. All turns completed under 150s (no 502). No stage/grade/level/rubric language on any turn. intervention.focus='writing' + writing_not_content_check non-empty on all 6 SSE turns. NO 'add more evidence' / counting / rigid-rule phrasing (regex bank covers 'add more evidence', 'need three/two/several sources/quotes/statistics', 'you should cite a source', 'back it up with more facts', 'one more example/statistic') and NO invented-content phrasing on any invitation. (h) FRONTEND — with ?dev + cleared localStorage the workspace loads directly (writing-area visible, no Teacher Setup gate); submitting the strong-evidence draft via continue-button produced an ai-invitation within ~60s; open-dev-panel-button opens the Development Panel showing THREE blocks side by side: Communicative Purpose (primary=persuade, secondary=[inform], inferred_from populated), Paragraph Function (M7, all 5 rows populated with purpose='Introduce the topic and assert an initial position.'), and the new EVIDENCE FUNCTION (M8) block with all 4 rows populated (forms=[statistic (cited study)], function='Meant to ground the claim that social media is a problem for friendships.', interpretation gap='The writer does not explain why frequent phone-checking indicates friendship harm; the interpretive step is missing.', quality (functional)='Potentially relevant but currently disconnected from a specific claim; sufficiency cannot be judged until the claim is clarified.'); new-test-session-button correctly resets the workspace to empty writing-area with no ai-invitation. Screenshot captured (/tmp/m8_devpanel.png) shows all three functional blocks stacked in the panel.

action_items: None blocking. Milestone 8 acceptance holds end-to-end. All six M8 acceptance criteria verified: (a) evidence_function.applies+function populated whenever support is present (formal or embedded), (b) evidence-vs-interpretation distinction — the AI targets WHY it matters, not 'more evidence', (c) NO counting/rigid rules/invented evidence on any invitation, (d) M5A focus='writing' + writing_not_content_check preserved on all turns, (e) M6 communicative_purpose.primary + M7 paragraph_function.applies+purpose preserved, (f) frontend evidence-function-block renders alongside paragraph-function-block and communicative-purpose-block.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py — EvidenceFunction model (lines 146-156) with default_factory on DevelopmentalTheory.evidence_function (line 164): every new session gets applies=False + empty fields. Verified via GET on a fresh session (test_create_get_patch_default_ef) — applies=False, function='', interpretation_gap='', forms=[] as expected.

server.py — FUNCTIONAL EVIDENCE FRAMEWORK block in SYSTEM_MESSAGE (lines 306-311) is crisp: (i) frames evidence as a communicative RESOURCE meaningful ONLY relative to M6 whole-purpose + M7 paragraph purpose + the claim/interpretation it supports; (ii) explicitly enumerates that support is NOT only facts/statistics/quotations — a process description or demonstration (explanation), sensory/descriptive details/actions/dialogue (narrative), and personal experiences/memories (reflection) all COUNT and set applies=true; (iii) instructs to ask 'Does the writer help the reader understand WHY this evidence matters?' — the evidence-vs-interpretation edge; (iv) preserves the M5A content boundary (may teach relevance/interpretation/connection, may NOT invent evidence/examples/stats/quotations unless brainstorming is on). Verified live on 6 drafts: applies=true in 6/6 cases with evidence present; interpretation_gap named on the strong-evidence/weak-interpretation case exactly as designed ('The statistic is dropped then "this proves" is asserted — no ...').

server.py — theory output schema for evidence_function (line 359) is well specified: it tells the LLM applies MUST be true only when evidence/support is present or at issue, requires forms/function/interpretation_gap/quality fields when applies=true, and requires them empty otherwise. The LLM honored this on every observed turn.

server.py — _compact_theory (lines 407-415) correctly surfaces evidence_function.model_dump() alongside paragraph_function into the per-turn prompt, which is what lets multi-turn reasoning carry forward evidence analysis. Verified in the multi-turn test: ef.applies stayed true across writing→revise→answer as evidence remained in focus, and the intervention arc consolidated on the real revision that added the missing interpretation.

The M8/M7/M6 coordination is empirically strong on paragraph drafts: the same submission produced cp.primary='persuade', pf.purpose='Introduce the topic and assert an initial position.', AND ef.function='Meant to ground the claim that social media is a problem for friendships.' — the three functional layers reasoned coherently together in one turn without any layer overwriting or crowding out the others.

The multi-turn intervention arc on the strong-ev/weak-interp → revised-with-interpretation → student-answer path was exactly what the DEVELOPMENTAL INSTRUCTION LAYER prescribes: instruct_then_invite (introduce the evidence-vs-interpretation gap) → consolidate (name the developmental change after the real revision) → invite_only (student has appropriated the concept). currently_relevant_domains cycled through ['Evidence','Interpretation / Reasoning','Paragraph Purpose'] → ['Interpretation / Reasoning','Paragraph Purpose'] → ['Paragraph Purpose','Interpretation / Reasoning'] — the Evidence domain naturally dropped out as the student demonstrated it, exactly the Recognize→Name→Understand→Use→Reflect trajectory.

frontend/DevelopmentPanel.jsx — evidence-function-block (lines 229-252) correctly gates rendering on theory.evidence_function?.applies. When applies=true the block renders all four fields (forms, function in amber, interpretation gap, quality (functional)) with the same visual grammar as the Paragraph Function and Communicative Purpose blocks. Verified in the browser: on the strong-evidence draft the block populated fully with sensible content. The applies=false gating is also correct — no empty M8 block clutters the panel when no evidence is in focus (e.g., a bare unsupported-claim session where the engine legitimately leaves applies=false).

The block ordering in DevelopmentPanel.jsx (communicative-purpose → paragraph-function → evidence-function) matches the pedagogical layering (whole → paragraph → evidence-within-paragraph), which reads well visually and mirrors the reasoner's own ordering.

M5A boundary held on the brainstorm exception per the earlier 30/30 eval (milestone8_evidence_eval.py case 30): with teacher_notes explicitly enabling brainstorming, focus flipped to 'content' and the AI discussed KINDS of evidence without inventing specific facts — consistent with the exception documented in milestone8_review.md.

Regression on rigid-rule guard: the exhaustive 30-case eval (milestone8_evidence_eval.py) plus the 6 live SSE turns in test_milestone8_evidence_function.py collectively produced 0/36 instances of 'add more evidence' / 'need N sources' / counting phrasing — the framework's core M8 discipline is holding at scale.
